answers.q1: Grounded. Each extracted item (Ken at 18:42, Sarah at 14:21) appears verbatim in the transcription panel on the right with matching timestamps and speakers. The quotes are directly from what was said, not AI inference.
answers.q2: The timestamp+speaker link (e.g., '18:42 Ken'). Click that to jump to the source in the transcription or recording.
answers.q3: Yes, clearly. Each note shows speaker name and timestamp: '18:42 Ken', '14:21 Sarah', etc. Time is precise to the minute.
answers.q4: Unclear. There's no visible edit button or pencil icon on the items. I'd try clicking the item itself or looking for an edit affordance in the 'アクション' or ' 決定事項' buttons at the bottom, but it's not obvious from this view.
answers.q5: Moderately confident (5/7). Items are grounded with clear sources, but I'd verify critical ones first before forwarding. The placeholder text '待っています...' under 'やること' and '決まったこと' creates uncertainty—are these real or incomplete extracts?

weaknesses.what: No visible edit UI. If an item is wrong (e.g., misattributed to wrong speaker or wrong time), there's no affordance to fix it in-place.
weaknesses.fix: Add edit icon (pencil) or hover state to extracted items. Or add an 'Edit extraction' mode.

weaknesses.what: Placeholder text '決まったことを待っています...' and 'やることを待っています...' creates ambiguity: are these real unresolved items, or is extraction still running? A first-time user won't know.
weaknesses.fix: Replace with 'No decisions yet' / 'No actions yet' or remove the section entirely until items exist. Add a spinner if actively extracting.

weaknesses.what: Left panel (extracted) and right panel (transcription) are visually separate. The connection between '18:42 Ken macOS を先に出します' (left) and its source in the transcript (right) requires scanning. No visual highlight or link.
weaknesses.fix: Highlight the corresponding transcript line when hovering an extracted item, or add a jump-to-source arrow.

weaknesses.what: Wasted whitespace in '決まったこと' and 'やること' sections when they're empty (just placeholders). Also, '14:21 Sarah オンボーディングを試作する' appears only in the メモ section; unclear why it's not categorized under 'やること'.
weaknesses.fix: Clarify categorization rules or auto-categorize memos into the right bucket. Hide empty sections until they have content.
